<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Contact Us | Computers Gold Coast</title>
<meta name="description" content="Get in touch with Computers Gold Coast. Fill out the form or call for computer, laptop, networking, CCTV and IT help across the Gold Coast. No call-out fees, onsite or remote, 7am to 10pm every day.">
<link rel="canonical" href="https://computersgoldcoast.com.au/contact">
<meta name="robots" content="index, follow, max-image-preview:large">
<meta property="og:type" content="website">
<meta property="og:title" content="Contact Us | Computers Gold Coast">
<meta property="og:description" content="Fill out the form or call for computer, laptop, networking, CCTV and IT help across the Gold Coast. No call-out fees, onsite or remote.">
<meta property="og:url" content="https://computersgoldcoast.com.au/contact">
<meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image">
<meta name="twitter:title" content="Contact Us | Computers Gold Coast">
<meta name="twitter:description" content="Fill out the form or call for computer, laptop and IT help across the Gold Coast.">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&family=Space+Grotesk:wght@500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root{
    --navy:#020617; --sky-50:#f0f9ff; --gray-50:#f9fafb; --gray-200:#e5e7eb;
    --accent:#38bdf8; --text:#0f172a; --text-soft:#475569;
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  body{font-family:'Inter',ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; color:var(--text); line-height:1.55; margin:0;}
  h1,h2,h3{font-family:'Space Grotesk',ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; font-weight:700; line-height:1.15; margin:0;}
  .wrap{max-width:1120px; margin:0 auto; padding:0 24px;}
  .eyebrow{font-size:13px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.12em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--accent); margin-bottom:12px; display:block;}
  section{padding:72px 0;}
  .pill{display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; border-radius:999px; padding:14px 28px; font-weight:600; font-size:15px; text-decoration:none; border:2px solid transparent; cursor:pointer; transition:transform .15s ease;}
  .pill:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);}
  .pill-primary{background:var(--accent); color:var(--navy);}
  .pill-dark{background:var(--navy); color:#fff;}

  .site-header{position:sticky; top:0; z-index:40; background:rgba(255,255,255,.95); backdrop-filter:blur(8px); border-bottom:1px solid var(--gray-200);}
  .site-header .wrap{display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; padding:14px 24px;}
  .brand{display:flex; flex-direction:column; text-decoration:none; color:var(--text); line-height:1.1;}
  .brand .word{font-family:'Space Grotesk'; font-weight:700; font-size:19px;}
  .brand .word span{color:var(--accent);}
  .brand .tagline{font-size:11px; color:var(--text-soft); font-weight:500;}
  nav{display:flex; gap:28px; align-items:center;}
  nav a{color:var(--text); text-decoration:none; font-size:14px; font-weight:500;}
  nav a:hover{color:var(--accent);}
  .header-cta{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px;}
  .nav-toggle{display:none; background:none; border:0; padding:6px; font-size:22px; line-height:1; cursor:pointer; color:var(--text);}
  .header-cta .pill{white-space:nowrap;}
  @media (max-width:900px){
    nav{display:none;}
    .nav-toggle{display:inline-flex;}
    .site-header.nav-open nav{display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:16px; position:absolute; top:100%; left:0; right:0; background:#fff; border-bottom:1px solid var(--gray-200); padding:18px 24px;}
  }

  .hero{background:var(--navy); color:#fff; padding:80px 0 64px;}
  .hero .badge{display:inline-flex; gap:8px; align-items:center; background:rgba(255,255,255,.08); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15); border-radius:999px; padding:8px 16px; font-size:13px; margin-bottom:24px;}
  .hero h1{font-size:44px; color:#fff; max-width:760px;}
  .hero h1 .accent{color:var(--accent);}
  .hero p.lead{max-width:620px; font-size:17px; color:#cbd5e1; margin:22px 0 0;}

  .bg-white{background:#fff;}
  .bg-gray{background:var(--gray-50);}
  .grid{display:grid; gap:40px;}
  .grid-2{grid-template-columns:1.2fr 1fr;}
  @media (max-width:900px){ .grid-2{grid-template-columns:1fr;} }
  .grid.path-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}
  @media (max-width:900px){ .grid.path-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;} }
  .path-card{background:var(--sky-50); border:1px solid var(--gray-200); border-radius:16px; padding:30px; display:flex; flex-direction:column;}
  .path-card h3{font-size:21px; margin-bottom:12px;}
  .path-card p{color:var(--text-soft); font-size:15px; margin:0 0 24px;}
  .path-card .pill{align-self:flex-start; margin-top:auto;}

  .form-field{margin-bottom:18px;}
  .form-field label{display:block; font-size:14px; font-weight:600; margin-bottom:6px;}
  .form-field input, .form-field select, .form-field textarea{
    width:100%; padding:12px 14px; border:1px solid var(--gray-200); border-radius:10px;
    font-family:inherit; font-size:15px; color:var(--text); background:#fff;
  }
  .form-field textarea{min-height:130px; resize:vertical;}
  .form-field input:focus, .form-field select:focus, .form-field textarea:focus{outline:2px solid var(--accent); border-color:var(--accent);}
  .hp{position:absolute; left:-9999px;}
  button.submit{background:var(--accent); color:var(--navy); border:0; border-radius:999px; padding:15px 34px; font-weight:600; font-size:15px; cursor:pointer; font-family:inherit;}
  button.submit:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);}

  .contact-card{background:var(--sky-50); border:1px solid var(--gray-200); border-radius:16px; padding:28px;}
  .contact-card h3{font-size:18px; margin-bottom:6px;}
  .contact-card .phone{font-family:'Space Grotesk'; font-size:30px; font-weight:700; color:var(--navy); text-decoration:none; display:inline-block; margin:6px 0 4px;}
  .contact-card .phone:hover{color:var(--accent);}
  .contact-card p{color:var(--text-soft); font-size:14.5px; margin:0 0 18px;}
  .contact-list{list-style:none; margin:18px 0 0; padding:18px 0 0; border-top:1px solid var(--gray-200); display:grid; gap:12px;}
  .contact-list li{display:flex; gap:10px; font-size:14.5px; color:var(--text-soft);}
  .contact-list li b{color:var(--text); font-weight:600;}
  .contact-list li::before{content:"✓"; color:var(--accent); font-weight:700;}

  footer{padding:48px 0; background:var(--navy); color:#cbd5e1;}
  footer p{color:#94a3b8; font-size:14px; margin:0;}
  .footer-bottom{border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1); padding-top:20px; margin-top:24px; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:12px; font-size:13px; color:#94a3b8;}
  footer a{color:#cbd5e1; text-decoration:none;}
  .topbar{background:var(--navy);}
  .topbar-inner{max-width:1120px; margin:0 auto; padding:7px 24px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:13px;}
  .open-status{display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:9px; font-weight:600; color:#fff;}
  .os-dot{width:9px; height:9px; border-radius:50%; background:#4ade80; flex:none;}
  .open-status.is-open .os-dot{animation:ospulse 1.5s ease-out infinite;}
  .open-status.is-closed .os-dot{background:#94a3b8;}
  .os-text{font-weight:700; color:#4ade80;}
  .open-status.is-closed .os-text{color:#cbd5e1;}
  .os-sep{color:#64748b;}
  .os-clock{color:var(--accent); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.02em;}
  @keyframes ospulse{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(74,222,128,.7);} 70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 6px rgba(74,222,128,0);} 100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(74,222,128,0);}}
</style>
bodyHtml:
📞 Onsite & Remote · 7am, 10pm, 7 Days

Let's Get Your Tech Sorted. Fast Quotes, Straight Answers.

If you already know what needs fixing, grab a repair quote and I'll come back with an accurate price. If something's playing up and you're not sure why, send me the details or call and we'll work it out. No call-out fees anywhere on the Gold Coast.

Two ways to get a price

What sounds like you?

Pick the one that fits and you'll get a faster, more accurate answer back from me.

I know what needs fixing

Cracked or dim screen, a charge port (DC jack) that only works at the right angle, a dead key or a whole keyboard, a battery that won't hold. If it's a laptop, MacBook or iMac and you already know the fault, this is the quick way to a real price. Fill in your model and what's wrong on the quote form and I'll get back to you with an accurate number instead of a rough guess over the phone.

Get a Repair Quote →

I'm not sure what's wrong

Desktop or laptop that won't start, running slow, throwing errors, or just not behaving and you can't say why. That's how most jobs come in and it's no problem at all. Send me the details in the form below or give me a call and we'll work out what's going on together.

Send Me the Details
Send A Message

Tell Me What You Need.

Or Call

Prefer To Talk?

Call the Gold Coast local

0447 266 455

Call or text any day between 7am and 10pm. If I'm on a job and can't pick up, leave a message and I'll call you straight back.

  • $0 call-out fees anywhere on the Gold Coast
  • Onsite or remote, whichever suits you
  • Open 7am, 10pm, 7 days a week
  • Family-owned, not a franchise
